channel.title: Pier & Point · 500 Terry A. Francois Boulevard
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for 500 Terry A. Francois Boulevard (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · 500 Terry A. Francois Boulevard: The map notes said tenants have included Cisco and Wix. The cited Clark Pacific, SF Chronicle and OpenStreetMap pages support Cisco (through its Meraki division) but never mention Wix, so a dated correction withdrawing Wix was added to the map notes. The Wikimedia aerial's credit now names only the Commons username Firstcultural, as the file page does.
